production.note: US model years 1999-2004. Quote (TFLtruck, Andre Smirnov): "1999-2004 Ford F-150 Lightning". F150Hub (enthusiast): "1999 - 2004", with yearly production 4,000 (1999) to 3,781 (2004) (f150hub-lightning). The 1993-1995 Lightning is the 1st gen; the 2022 F-150 Lightning EV is unrelated.

body.note: F150Hub (enthusiast): "2wd, regular cab, step side bed". Auto123 (Alex Law, 2001): 'built on the F-Series regular cab, short-wheelbase chassis' (auto123-lightning-2001). Regular cab with the Flareside bed is the only configuration and the standard car.

configuration.note: Ford-Trucks.com: 'Configuration Longitudinally mounted, single overhead cam, 90-degree Triton™ V-8 supercharged/intercooled'.

aspiration.note: 'Eaton™ Corporation Generation IV Roots-type supercharger; water-to-air intercooler'

drivetrain.note: F150Hub: '2wd'; Ford-Trucks.com: 'Rear axle 9.75-in. ring gear with limited-slip differential, 3.73:1 ratio' (fordtrucks-lightning-2001-specs).

transmission.note: 'Four-speed automatic (4R100)', the only transmission; F150Hub: 'Ford 4R100 4 speed automatic' (f150hub-lightning); Cars.com: 'A/T 4-Speed A/T' (carscom-lightning-2001).

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL (single named-author article, plus an enthusiast spec page and a TV road-test panel). 2001 rating. Quote (Auto123, Alex Law, 2001): "For 2001, the SVT Lightning's SOHC 5.4-liter Triton V8 engine develops 380 horsepower at 4,750 rpm, up 20 horsepower from the 2000 model." Ford-Trucks.com 2001 specifications: "380 hp @ 4,750 rpm" (fordtrucks-lightning-2001-specs). F150Hub: "360 hp @ 4,750 rpm (1999 & 2000 model years)" and "380 hp @ 4,750 rpm (2001 - 2004 model years)" (f150hub-lightning). Cars.com 2001 Reg Cab Flareside: "SAE Net Horsepower @ RPM: 380 @ 4750" (carscom-lightning-2001). MotorWeek's 2001 road-test panel also lists 380 hp (motorweek-lightning-2001; no individual author). 380 hp covers 2001-2004, four of six model years, so the record uses it; 1999-2000 trucks were rated 360 hp.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (database). 2001 F-150 Lightning, Reg Cab Flareside 120" (regular cab, automatic, the only configuration). Quote (Cars.com): "Curb Weight: 4,670 lbs"; the same page gives "SAE Net Horsepower @ RPM: 380 @ 4750". Ford-Trucks.com's '2001 SVT F-150 Lightning Specifications' prints the same figure, "Curb weight 4,670 lb. (2,120 kg)" (fordtrucks-lightning-2001-specs), but has no byline or stated source, so it is corroboration only and not counted as a second source.

Weight (4,670 lb, 2001) rests on Cars.com (database), with the same figure on Ford-Trucks.com, which has no byline or stated source and is not counted as independent. A Ford/SVT 2001 press kit or specification sheet, or a major magazine spec panel, would replace both.
